title: Fervent Manipulations
subtitle: Flammeus — blood remembers burning
text: The Fervent tendency belongs to blood that has absorbed the violence of fire — things that burn, things that are burned. Sanguine Ignition (QUICK, 125): set a target alight using the heat stored in your blood. Pyretic Forge (QUICK, 350): superheat your blood to smelt and craft where no furnace stands. Vitric Combustion (QUICK, ?): crystallize blood heat into a short-range explosive burst. These are not gentle manipulations. Blood that carries Flammeus does not cool easily.
